user.title: Add Climate Wire Pilot thermostat
user.description: Create a climate entity that controls a wire pilot heater via a select or light entity.

data_description.heater: Entity used to control the wire pilot modes: a select entity (e.g. Legrand) or a light entity (e.g. Qubino ZMNHJD1).
data_description.temperature_sensor: Temperature sensor that reflects the current temperature.
data_description.power_sensor: Power sensor to monitor heater power consumption for HVAC action detection.
data_description.power_threshold: Power threshold in Watts above which the heater is considered to be heating.

error.unsupported_select: This select entity does not expose the wire pilot modes (Off, Frost protection, Eco, Comfort -2, Comfort -1, Comfort).

deprecated_yaml.title: The Climate Wire Pilot YAML configuration is being removed
deprecated_yaml.description:
Your Climate Wire Pilot thermostats configured in YAML have been imported into the UI.

Remove the `climate_wire_pilot` platforms from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
